name: alfa-store
description: ALFA by Alfa Infinity: React storefront and owner CMS with a Node.js/SQLite backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
